description: This file defines the TimesheetRow class within the OrangeHRM Time module. It models a row of timesheet entries associated with a project and activity, managing dates, total hours, and assignment of individual TimesheetItem objects.

classes.name: TimesheetRow
classes.description: Represents a row in a timesheet, linked to a specific project and activity, with date management, total hours calculation, and timesheet item assignment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TimesheetRow with a specific project, activity, and set of dates.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Returns the project associated with this timesheet row.

methods.name: getProjectActivity
methods.description: Returns the activity associated with this timesheet row.

methods.name: setDates
methods.description: Formats and sets the dates for this timesheet row.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total hours accumulated for this row.

methods.name: incrementTotal
methods.description: Increments the total hours by a specified amount.

methods.name: assignTimesheetItem
methods.description: Associates a TimesheetItem with a specific date in this row, throwing an exception if a timesheet item is already assigned for that date.

methods.name: getTimesheetItems
methods.description: Retrieves all timesheet items associated with this row.
